research.text: To date, our science and technology have entered an era where innovations are powered by data-driven tools. Meanwhile, our chemical industries are embracing for a highly automated future. Our research will contribute solutions to a more resiliant and digitalized world by deploying interdisciplinary technologies to empower material innovations in chemistry and processing through the integration of first-principle theories, multi-scale modelling, advanced computing and characterizations as well as informatics and data science.
